name: Big and Skewb Utah 2019
information:
* Skewb is the main event of the competition.
* It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
* No outside food and drink is allowed in the venue.
* Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww) will give you an example of how a competition work.
